{{Quote|Tell me, soldier. You're not ready to say your last words, are you?''"<br />"''No, sir.''"<br />"''Good! Because if you don't stay alive, you'll never know your nickname!|Clone Captain Lock and a wounded 5177|<ref name="SM1" />}}
'''Chatterbox''' was the ironically-given nickname to a quiet and reserved [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Breakout Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Originally only known by his designation of '''CT-5177''', he served in the [[Mission to Kynachi]]. He hardly talked at all, which led to one [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] to say that Chatterbox would beat [[Knuckles (Breakout Squad)|Knuckles]] in a quiet contest, as he didn't even snore. Along with fellow troopers Breaker, Sharp and Knuckles, he formed the famed [[Breakout Squad]], led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]]. On a diplomatic mission into [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Lalo Gunn]] developed a liking for him. They then became trapped by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] but escaped using an ancient [[Infinity Gate|artifact]]. Breakout Squad and Chatterbox then went to Vaced, and an imagecaster led them to [[Bilbringi Depot]]. There, he was shot by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] and wounded. Breakout Squad then returned to Coruscant. Their next mission was to escort a freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and then rescued [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on [[Foless/Legends|Foless]].

==Biography==
===Breakout Squad's formation===
CT-5177, who would go onto be dubbed Chatterbox, was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="SM1" /> a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="DB" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> Chatterbox served on the [[Mission to Kynachi|mission]] to [[Kynachi]], under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]]. Their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was ambushed, leading to the death of Lock and the disappearance of Ambase. Chatterbox and his fellow clones, along with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nuru Kungurama]], rallied and liberated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from its occupation by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and [[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] [[Umbrag]]. The clones became known as the [[Breakout Squad]]. The squad was able to acquire transport from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lalo Gunn]] on her [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''.<ref name="SM1" />

===Lost in the black hole===
On orders from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Breakout Squad ventured to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] for a meeting at [[Ifpe'a|Defense Force Station Ifpe'a]]. There they met [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Sev'eere'nuruodo]] and rescued her from a Techno Union attack. After escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], they became trapped near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] with [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. Kungurama and Breakout Squad located an ancient [[Infinity Gate]] with a pair of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]]. During the mission, Chatterbox grew close to Captain Gunn.<ref name="SM2">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>

===Chase on Vaced===
En route to Coruscant, Breakout Squad was contacted by Chancellor Palpatine and asked to [[Mission to Vaced|divert to]] [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] to meet Kynachi's [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]]. The Commissioner was assassinated just after his arrival. Chatterbox and Breakout Squad pursued the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]]. They got onboard Gunn's ship and clashed with the sniper's [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|transport]], which ended with both ships crashing and the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of the sniper. Gunn and Breakout Squad parted ways, but not before she shared a kiss with Chatterbox. Kungurama found an imagecaster which led Breakout Squad to take Sommilor's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to [[Bilbringi Depot]], where they [[Battle of Bilbringi Depot|clashed]] with Umbrag again. They freed the depot from the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, but the last battle droid shot Chatterbox in the back.<ref name="SM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>

===Confrontation on Coruscant===
Breakout Squad finished the investigation of the Depot, and discovered that the Sommilor who had been killed on Vaced was an [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|impostor]]; the real Sommilor was freed from his captivity in the freighter's hold. Clone [[Medic/Legends|medics]] arrived and stabilized Chatterbox, with the rest of Breakout Squad donating [[Blood/Legends|blood]], excepting [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]]. They then returned to Coruscant, where they planned on taking Chatterbox to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for treatment. Jedi Master [[Harro Kelpura]], though, ordered the freighter to change course to his lab in [[Dacho District]], which had been broken into. The ship was then damaged by an impact with another [[Sleight of Hand|dropship]], which crashed but was able to take off and escape. After Kungurama confronted his missing master, Ambase, Chatterbox was returned to the Temple for care. He recovered in time for Breakout Squad to investigate the disappearances of the [[Spice Siren/Legends|''Spice Siren'']].<ref name="SM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

===Pirates and younglings===
Breakout Squad's next mission was to escort [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] freighter to [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. When they arrived at the rendezvous on [[Affa/Legends|Affa]], they discovered a massacre, but they continued their mission to Fondor, where they [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|defeated]] the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Dool Pundar]]. Once there, their ally [[Gizman|Gizz]] befriended a blind [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Kuvuta Pindi]]. Kungurama agreed to help her escort orphaned [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to [[Foless/Legends|Foless]]. Once there, they realized Pindi was trying to steal the orphans, and gave chase. They captured Pundar and freed the younglings, but Pindi was killed.<ref name="Strange Allies">''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Chatterbox appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers series, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]''. He and Breakout Squad was first pictured in the comic [[Opress Unleashed|''The Clone Wars: Opress Unleashed'']], a comic released in [[2011]] as part of [[Free Comic Book Day]] and later included in the comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]''.
